summary: An attendance list for a Network Working Group meeting held at the University of Illinois in February 1971, added as a supplement to the official meeting notes. It simply names the people present, grouped by their sites, such as BBN, Harvard and Illinois. Useful mostly as a record of who was working on the early network.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 108 adds the attendee list for the Urbana Network Working Group meeting held from February 17 to 19, 1971. It groups names under their listed organizations or sites.

sections.title: An Addendum to the Meeting Notes
sections.content: R. Watson of SRI-ARC prepared RFC 108 as an addendum to the NWG meeting notes identified as NIC 5762. The document contains the attendance list for the Urbana meeting held February 17 through 19, 1971.
sections.plainLanguage: This addendum supplies the attendee list for the Urbana Network Working Group meeting.

sections.title: Names Grouped by Site
sections.content:
The list groups participants under the organizations or sites shown in the RFC, including BBN, Harvard, Illinois, MIT, RAND, SRI, UCLA, UCSB, and Utah. It records each attendee's name under a site heading.

The RFC provides no technical discussion or protocol details; its content is the attendance list.
sections.plainLanguage: The names are arranged by the organization or site listed for each participant. The document does not discuss network design.

sections.title: Relation to RFC 101
sections.content: The unit metadata records that RFC 108 updates RFC 101. The RFC text identifies itself as an addendum to the NWG meeting notes and supplies the Urbana attendance list.
sections.plainLanguage: RFC 108 adds an attendance list to the meeting notes and updates RFC 101.
